Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE cohesive photorealistic cassette player with an inserted cassette, for a pastel tabletop portfolio.
Input reference: the white portable cassette player in the middle of the supplied desk image is a material, camera and industrial-design reference ONLY. Do not reproduce the webpage, plants or desk composition.
Create a single physically manufactured compact white portable cassette player with a translucent pale blue standard cassette fully and snugly seated inside its closed clear smoked-glass door. Player, cassette, black wound tape, white hubs, mechanical buttons and glass must belong to ONE coherent 3D render with identical camera, physical scale and soft upper-left illumination. Premium realistic product photography, refined matte ivory polymer, subtle microtexture, satin silver screws, shallow bevels, correct contact shadows, real glass thickness and restrained reflection. Avoid illustration and graphic/vector appearance.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024, object centered. Player body approximately x=175..1370, y=120..910. Body width to height approximately 1.55. Small transparent margins. Genuine transparent background; no glow, no blue aura, no tabletop, no extra objects. Camera looks slightly down on broad face, about 20 degrees from its normal, only a narrow bottom thickness visible. Camera yaw and roll ZERO: left and right edges have the same perspective, horizontal level hub axis, symmetrical seating. Not an isometric or diagonal player.
Cassette: realistically blue-tinted transparent molded shell, real white paper labels top and bottom completely BLANK, no writing, no sticker. Black tape is wound as clean concentric packs, larger left pack and smaller right pack, around two identical fine detailed off-white toothed hubs. Black tape never runs horizontally through the center gap. Hubs actually engage player spindles, sit on exactly the same plane, identical hub diameter. Tape almost fills the physical bay, no large empty margins; its shell perimeter and lower guide portion are partially hidden UNDER the player door bezel, not pasted above the glass. Front door casts real narrow occlusion shadows onto the cassette inside it.
Bay: roughly x=265..1100, y=285..780. Above bay one blank white nameplate, no writing.
Transport: a right-hand vertical bank of FOUR real raised compact matte white mechanical keys recessed in slim sockets, gently rounded corners, visible bevel and shallow thickness, matching the player plastic. Buttons approximate x=1170..1280, y=310..720. They are real manufactured keys, not flat website cards. Embossed or engraved small desaturated blue symbols only: play triangle, stop square, fast-forward double-right triangle, rewind double-left triangle in that order top to bottom. No other symbols, no text, no VOL word. Not cartoon icons.
Top edge has one small brushed volume knob and small headphone socket, naturally integrated.
Avoid: graphic black disks, huge stylized gear icons, flat pasted paper, over-exposed glossy plastic, inconsistent perspective, cassette visible wholly outside the bay, melted geometry, UI labels, interface overlays, watermark, multiple views, duplicate objects. Deliver only the coherent single product.
